title: 第七章 打劫第八章 虎入羊群
content_zh:
“少爷，你没事……吧。”青儿听到响声，还以为出了什么事，结果一进来便看到了楚天舒的……裸体。
“哗啦——”
水声激荡，楚天舒蓦然自那已变得浑浊的药液中长身而起。刹那间，他全身骨骼发出一连串清脆而密集的噼啪声响，好似一串爆竹炸响。
浓郁的水汽如白纱般缭绕升腾，刀刻般的肌肉若隐若现。
楚天舒自木盆中走出，青儿上前拿下浴布，帮他擦干身体。
“灵泽一级！”青儿小嘴张大，惊讶道，“少爷，竟然这么快就突破了灵泽境！”
“就算是上等资质也需要半个月，少爷仅用了短短几个时辰就完成了突破！真的是独灵脉吗？”青儿心想道。
“收拾收拾，把剩下的药材都藏好。”楚天舒挪挪脚，将灵阵一角擦去，十凶拘灵阵顿时停止了运转。
“嗯。”青儿道。
“这几天你不管听到什么关于我的传闻都不要和他人争论，”楚天舒想了想道，“还有……接下来几天我都不去学堂了，你告诉爹娘，就说我心情不好。”
……
楚家，学堂。
资质检测过后，楚家新一代的少年们便会进入学堂修行，学堂内会有专门的家老任讲师，向少年们传授修行知识，指导修炼。
“欸，听说了没有？那个天才楚天舒被未婚妻上门退婚。”
“什么天才？那就是独灵脉的废物罢了！”
“对了，据说半年后他还要和楚玥一战。”
“约战？得了，不过是自欺欺人。”
“就是，人家楚玥已是脉络境修为，他还妄想着企及，真是不知天高地厚。”
听着同学们的议论，楚天清似乎理解了哥哥为什么不愿来学堂。
“那家伙虽然废物但他弟弟可不一样，是七灵脉。”

众人说着回头瞟了一眼，楚天清突然有些开心，这种万众瞩目的感觉真好！
“切，不过七灵脉罢了，我鹤哥可是八灵脉，稳压他一头。”不合时宜的声音传来，这令楚天清眉头一皱，但他又不好意思再说什么。自卑再度涌上心头，就像当初面对哥哥那样，面对八灵脉的楚将鹤，生怕得罪他。
就在众人谈笑之际，一位家老走了过来，那正是学堂的讲师：楚穆。
见到来人，少年们连忙回到座位。只因这位家老是出了名的严厉，罚起学子来可谓毫不留情，处罚力度之大，就连长老都劝不住。
只因楚穆已然半只脚踏入了丹心境，是楚家未来的顶尖战力，又有族长一脉在背后撑腰，其他长老都不敢轻易得罪。
“好，这堂课我们来讲讲如何入门。”楚穆道，“你们都已检查出灵脉，那么接下来就是该如何进入灵泽境，迈出修行的第一步。”
“灵，生天地之间，灵脉则可感天地灵气，纳灵气于脉间。这一步，须冥想，配合吐纳之术。”楚穆将修炼要诀娓娓道来，“随后便是靠口鼻吐纳，不断从天地中吸取灵气，待到灵气充盈脉时，即可浓缩为灵液，待到灵液填满灵脉，就可以开辟灵泽了。”
“你们当中不乏有资质较高者，灵脉数量在常人之上，口鼻吐纳天地灵气的速度也是常人的数倍。”楚穆道。
content_en:
"Master, are you okay...?" Qing'er heard the noise and thought something happened, but as soon as he came in, he saw Chu Tianshu's... naked body.
"Wow--"
The sound of water stirred, and Chu Tianshu suddenly stood up from the turbid liquid. In an instant, all the bones in his body made a series of crisp and dense crackling sounds, like a string of firecrackers exploding.
The thick water vapor curled up and rose like white gauze, and the muscles like knife carvings were looming.
Chu Tianshu walked out of the tub, and Qing'er stepped forward to take the bath cloth and help him dry his body.
"Lingze level one!" Qing'er opened her mouth wide and said in surprise, "Young master, you have broken through the Lingze level so quickly!"
"Even the upper-class qualifications take half a month, but the young master completed the breakthrough in just a few hours! Is it really a unique spiritual vein?" Qing'er thought to himself.
"Pack it up and hide the remaining medicinal materials." Chu Tianshu moved his feet and wiped away a corner of the spirit array, and the Ten Evil Spiritual Array suddenly stopped operating.
"Yeah." Qing'er said.
"No matter what rumors you hear about me these days, don't argue with others," Chu Tianshu thought for a while and said, "Also... I won't go to school for the next few days. If you tell my parents, just say I'm in a bad mood."
…
Chu family, school.
After passing the qualification test, the new generation of young people from the Chu family will enter the school to practice. There will be dedicated family elders as lecturers in the school to teach the young people the knowledge of cultivation and guide their practice.
"Hey, have you heard? That genius Chu Tianshu was divorced by his fiancée."
"What kind of genius? That's just a waste of Dulingmai!"
"By the way, it is said that he will fight Chu Yue in half a year."
"A fight? Come on, you're just deceiving yourself."
"That's right, Chu Yue is already at the Meridian Realm, and he still wants to achieve it. He really doesn't know how high the world is."
Listening to the discussions among his classmates, Chu Tianqing seemed to understand why his brother did not want to come to school.
"Although that guy is useless, his brother is different. He has seven spiritual veins."
Everyone said and glanced back. Chu Tianqing suddenly felt happy. It felt so good to be in the spotlight!
"Tch, it's just seven spiritual veins. I, Brother He, have eight spiritual veins, so I can stabilize his end." An inappropriate voice came, which made Chu Tianqing frown, but he was too embarrassed to say anything else. Inferiority welled up in his heart again, just like when he faced his brother, Chu Jianghe was afraid of offending him when facing the Eight Spiritual Veins.
While everyone was talking and laughing, an elder came over. It was the lecturer of the school: Chu Mu.
Seeing the visitor, the teenagers quickly returned to their seats. Just because this patriarch is famous for being strict, he is merciless in punishing his students. The punishment is so severe that even the elders cannot dissuade him.
Just because Chu Mu has already half-stepped into Dan's state of mind, he is the top combat power of the Chu family in the future, and he has the support of the clan leader, so other elders do not dare to offend him easily.
"Okay, in this class we will talk about how to get started." Chu Mu said, "You have all checked your spiritual veins, so the next step is how to enter the Lingze realm and take the first step in practice."
"The spirit is born between the heaven and the earth. The spiritual veins can sense the spiritual energy of the heaven and the earth and absorb the spiritual energy in the veins. This step requires meditation and the technique of breathing in and out." Chu Mu explained the key points of cultivation. "Then, breathing through the mouth and nose is used to continuously absorb the spiritual energy from the heaven and the earth. When the spiritual energy fills the veins, it can be concentrated into spiritual liquid. When the spiritual liquid fills the spiritual veins, the spiritual lake can be opened."
"There are many among you who are highly qualified. Their number of spiritual veins is higher than that of ordinary people, and the speed of breathing in the spiritual energy of heaven and earth through their mouth and nose is also several times that of ordinary people." Chu Mu said.
